text:
Marta Rivera: Quick sync — proposing a new 'Scale' add-on for enterprise customers: guaranteed burst credits, priority routing, and a soft quota over commits. Need input on launch criteria and contract constraints.
Alex Chen: +1. Can we define the minimum commit, burst caps, and the SLOs? e.g., commit = 2TB tokens/mo, burst = 5x for 30m/day?
Devon Park: Concerned about support lift for priority routing. If we promise routing SLA we need fallback behavior documented. 
Sami Qureshi: Sales wants clear levers: price per commit, optional burst pack, and an overage rate. Also need negotiable vs non-negotiable items.
Priya Nair: From finance: we need an expected blended unit price and margin targets. Also telemetry to verify usage vs commit before billing.
Alex Chen: Suggest launch gating: 1) telemetry confirms <5% underreported cache hits, 2) performance tests with sustained bursts 3x above baseline on Dedicated pool, 3) automated fallback policy validated.
Marta Rivera: Good. What about contract language for burst enforcement? Do we meter bursts as tokens or time-windowed units?
Sami Qureshi: Customers prefer predictability — meter as "burst credits" consumed per token, with a monthly allotment and refill on renew. Overage should be a higher per-token rate or throttled fallback.
Devon Park: Throttle fallback messy for customer UX. Recommend auto-fallback to a lower-cost model variant when burst exhausted, plus clear UI/usage notifications. 
Priya Nair: Pricing sketch (for discussion):
```
Scale Add-on: commit 2TB/mo -> $40k/mo
Burst Pack: +5x 30m/day -> $8k/mo
Overage: $0.0025/token
```
Margins assume 30% infra cost reduction via batching/caching.
Billing Bot: New pricing draft saved: /pricing/drafts/scale-add-on-1955554321. Owner: @marta
Alex Chen: Launch checklist items (short): 
- define commit/burst metric semantics
- observability: per-customer token stream + cache hit rate
- fallback policy implemented + tested
- contract clause drafted (burst credit, priority routing limits, termination)
- support runbook + escalation path
Marta Rivera: For launch criteria, propose we require at least 2 pilot customers live for 4 weeks with zero P0 incidents and predictable cost within +/-12% of forecast. Thoughts?
Devon Park: Fine, but add: internal runbook validated by SRE and oncall drill completed.
Sami Qureshi: Also add a template contract appendix for legal that states non-disruptive enforcement and data residency constraints.
Priya Nair: Agree. Also require finance sign-off on pricing floor and realization modeling.
Marta Rivera: ok I'll draft the contract appendix and pilot checklist. @Alex will you own telemetry/instrumentation?
Alex Chen: Yep, will add metrics + dashboards. ETA EOW for pilot dashboard.
Marta Rivera: Great. If no objections I'll move this to proposal PR tomorrow and tag legal/finance for review. :thumbsup:
